name: Qamishli

requests.outcome: Official SANA report: electronic land-registry service launched through Maamelati/Anjez; coverage described as limited to selected provinces and expanding. No Qamishli parcel viewer, API URL, schema, CRS, or parcel geometry exposed.

Official SANA report: electronic registry service expansion to eight named provinces. Hasakah/Qamishli was not evidenced in the listed coverage. This is a service-scope limitation, not evidence of cadastral absence.
Official English SANA report: national archiving and future automation of land-registry records discussed. No public parcel map/API or bounded ID+geometry response exposed.

Official provincial service catalog demonstrates that cadastral-plan and registry-extract requests are handled as services, but it is not a Qamishli/Hasakah parcel viewer and exposes no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.

viewerInspection.details: Discovery did not identify an official Qamishli map viewer URL, current viewer JavaScript bundle, configuration, or public map/API service to inspect. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, private token, or unsafe registry fields were attempted.

schemaCrs.details: No public parcel response was obtained; native field schema, CRS, geometry encoding, and stable parcel identity could not be verified.

scopeLimits: Official national registry announcements establish institutional responsibility and digitization activity, not Qamishli parcel coverage.
The service announcements' listed provincial coverage does not include Hasakah/Qamishli, but this cannot establish citywide absence of paper, restricted, local, or future digital records.
No exact-point query was issued because no public parcel endpoint was discovered.
No map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is treated as citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, transaction, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: High: a real Qamishli/Hasakah cadastral source may exist behind local, restricted, paper, authenticated, or not-yet-public services. Independent serial review is required before any adapter or source admission.
